issues.title: BiDi text ordering and header overlap
issues.description: Relative time strings render in reverse order ('h ago 2') and the 'LineState' column header lacks proper spacing.
issues.evidence: Table shows 'h ago 2' instead of '2 h ago' and 'LineState' header text runs together.
issues.suggestion: Wrap timestamps in dir='ltr' or isolate numbers, and add proper column spacing.
issues.triageNote: Real bidi defect, but composed in the eval page (src/app/eval/pair-172/page.tsx, not editable): raw leading-digit strings ('2 h ago') render into Card slots with no dir isolation, so the UBA detaches the leading number ('h ago 2'); the 'LineState' overlap is the page's own 14px grid column overflowing under the 'State' header. Card.tsx itself renders slots correctly. Hardened the component demo (dir='ltr' on its own leading-digit/time meta strings, e.g. '96s build · 214 checks passed' which splits the same way) and documented the isolation pattern in meta.ts usage.

issues.title: Header Kerning Artifacts
issues.description: Unintended letter spacing creates visible gaps within header text words.
issues.evidence: Text displays as 'Delivera ble' and 'assistan t' in card header labels.
issues.suggestion: Normalize font tracking and kerning across card header typography styles.
issues.triageNote: No tracking/kerning/letter-spacing classes exist on Card or the pair-118 header spans (plain text-body-medium/font-medium tokens); uniform tracking cannot produce mid-word gaps like 'Delivera ble', pair-118's overall verdict was pass, and an independent VLM re-pass found rendering normal — JPEG-artifact misread of small caption text.
